title: Signed-in seller pages have unnamed controls, an unlabelled field, low contrast and small targets
location: frontend-next/views/BusinessAnalytics.tsx:464-468 (icon Button inside Link, no name: 10 button-name + 10 link-name)
frontend-next/views/Referral.tsx:171,184 (unnamed copy buttons), :179 (unlabelled link input), :158 (text-white/90 on gradient)
frontend-next/views/Wallet.tsx (text-white/70 balance label and currency on gradient)
steps: Local production build, axe-core 4.12.1 (WCAG 2.0-2.2 A/AA) on 50 pages as guest and member, light and dark (scripts/browser/reaudit-a11y-scan.cjs).
40 of 50 pages clean in light, 41 in dark; failures listed above, identical in both themes except contrast.
expected: Zero axe violations on every page, including signed-in seller pages.
actual: Analytics: 10 nested interactive controls without a name; Referral: two unnamed buttons and an unlabelled field; Inventory: one unnamed button; contrast failures on Wallet, Referral, Privacy, Inventory, Analytics and the public showroom header; target-size failures on feed, explore, profile and product pages.
impact: Screen-reader users cannot tell what the edit and copy buttons do on core seller screens; low-vision users struggle with white-on-gradient text; small targets are hard on phones. The CI axe check covers public pages only, so these slipped through.
fix: Give the Analytics edit link an aria-label and render it as a single Link styled as a button (no nested Button); add aria-label to Referral copy buttons and a label to the link field; replace text-white/70-90 on gradients with text-white or a darker gradient; make the post business link and stars at least 24x24 (padding). Extend the CI axe spec to signed-in pages.
